title: Gameplay Programmer Intern
descriptionText:
Join us for a summer internship building gameplay systems in Unity and C#.
You must be currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program in Computer Science, graduating in 2027 or 2028.
Candidates must be 18 years of age or older.
Experience with Git and debugging is a plus.
